resources.string: Start Guided Clean (Tap → Clear Cache → Back)
To show real cache sizes per app, this app needs the special "Usage access" permission. Find "Cache Cleaner" in the next screen and enable it.

Lets Cache Cleaner automatically tap "Clear cache" on the Settings screen it opens for you, and go back, during Guided Clean. It only acts while a Guided Clean run is in progress, and only looks for the cache button — never "Clear storage" or "Clear data".
Auto-Click is ON — Guided Clean will tap "Clear cache" and go back by itself.
Auto-Click is off — you'll need to tap "Clear cache" and Back yourself each screen.
